title: Prenuvo button
description: Bold pill buttons in the display face. Gradient is a green-to-teal pill (ocean runs green to blue) that takes on a seafoam tint and a light rim on hover; outline is a translucent pill with a light rim for dark backdrops; soft is a teal-tinted pill with a thin ink rim that fills with ink on hover. All changes take 0.2s.
notes: outline and soft follow the foreground colour, so they flip with the dark class
